description: DNS records of a domain (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, CAA, SOA) resolved live through the public AdGuard DNS JSON resolver (NextDNS as backup). Shows answers as they resolve now, with TTLs; it does not walk the delegation chain or query the authoritative servers directly. Choose this tool for: DNS records of a domain resolved live through the public. Close alternatives on this server: security_dmarc_spf_dkim (Email authentication DNS records for a domain: DMARC); security_dns_caa_records (Lists the CAA records published on a domain: which CAs may). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

types.description: Comma list of record types from A,AAAA,MX,NS,TXT,CNAME,CAA,SOA (default A,AAAA,MX,NS,TXT)
